definition: δια-τί  , why, Mat.9:11, 14 Mrk.2:18, Jhn.7:45, al.; δ. τό, with inf., Mrk.5:4, Luk.9:7, Jas.4:2.  __3. In composition, __(1) through, as in διαβαίνω;  __(2) of separation, asunder, as in διασπάω;  __(3) of distribution, abroad, as in διαγγέλλω;  __(4) of transition, as διαλλάσσω;  __(5) of "perfective" action (M, Pr., 112f., 115f.), as διαφύγω, διακαθαρίζω.  (AS)
